Title: Native crash ingested and session viewable
Description: Trigger a native crash in the RN app and confirm it lands in _rumdata as a crash and the crashed session is viewable in the dashboard
Preconditions: App installed on emulator; SDK wired to OpenObserve
Steps - Action: Run crash Maestro flow (tap Trigger native crash then relaunch) | Query _rumdata for error with is_crash | Open the session in the dashboard
Steps - Expected Result: Crash event present with error_is_crash and message | Session detail renders with breadcrumbs

Title: Crash inspectable in Error Tracking tab
Description: Confirm the crash is displayed in the RUM Error Tracking tab
Preconditions: A crash exists for the service
Steps - Action: Open RUM Error Tracking | Look for the crash message
Steps - Expected Result: Crash message is visible in Error Tracking

Title: Network fetch captured as resource
Description: Make HTTP requests from the app and confirm they are tracked as resources
Steps - Action: Run network Maestro flow (Fetch success + Fetch 404)
Steps - Expected Result: _rumdata has resource rows including the fetched URL

Title: Handled JS error ingested
Description: Report a handled error via the SDK and confirm ingestion
Steps - Expected Result: _rumdata has an error row with the handled message and source SOURCE

Title: Named views recorded
Description: Navigate multiple screens and confirm named views are recorded
Steps - Action: Run navigation Maestro flow (Home Details Checkout)
Steps - Expected Result: _rumdata has view rows named Home Details and Checkout

Title: Session Replay masks PII
Description: Visit a screen with PII and confirm the replay masks it (MASK_ALL)
Preconditions: App built with MASK_ALL; app installed
Steps - Action: Run masking Maestro flow (open Checkout) | Open session replay
Steps - Expected Result: No raw PII text (email or card) appears in the replay DOM

Title: Background foreground continuity
Description: Background then foreground the app and confirm the session continues
Steps - Expected Result: Same session id continues; no new session within timeout

Title: Offline buffering
Description: Use the app offline then reconnect and confirm buffered data is sent
Steps - Action: Airplane mode on | act | airplane mode off
Steps - Expected Result: Events buffered offline arrive after reconnect

Title: No phone home
Description: Confirm the SDK never targets a Datadog host
Steps - Action: Scan the APK for datadoghq/ddog-gov hosts

Title: Attributes tagged correctly
Description: Confirm env service and version are set on RUM data
